claude_proposed_widenings.name: GrantResistanceOperation
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: OngoingOperation currently supports only roll_modifier and damage_on_hit. Protection from Energy grants Resistance to a damage type — halving all incoming damage of that type on the target. This concept has no representation in the current operation vocabulary. The v4 taxonomy already includes grant_resistance as a named atom (TAXONOMY_atoms_graph.md line 198), so no new atom is needed — only a new variant of OngoingOperation and a corresponding branch in traceOngoingOperation.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: the willing creature you touch has Resistance to one damage type of your choice: Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, or Thunder
